prompt_text: Who is the best interior painting company in St. Louis MO?
answer_verbatim:
There isn’t one objectively “best” interior painter in St. Louis—quality can vary by crew, neighborhood, project size, and finish level. But **CertaPro Painters of St. Louis** is a solid mainstream starting point for many homeowners because it is established, insured, provides written estimates, and typically offers workmanship warranties. Be sure to evaluate the *specific local franchise and crew*, not just the national brand.

For a higher-end or more detailed interior job, I’d recommend getting quotes from at least three locally reviewed painters and comparing:

- Proof of insurance and workers’ compensation  
- Written scope: prep, patching, caulking, primer, number of coats, and cleanup  
- Paint brand/product line—not just “premium paint”  
- Who moves/protects furniture and floors  
- Warranty terms in writing  
- Recent interior-project references and photos  
- Whether the same crew will perform the work  

A “best” contractor should be willing to do thorough prep work—repairing drywall flaws, sanding, caulking trim, protecting floors, and using two finish coats where needed—not simply offer the lowest price.

If you share your St. Louis ZIP code, room count, and whether you want budget, midrange, or high-end workmanship, I can help narrow down what type of company to look for and what a fair estimate should include.
